title: Photo Intake Receipt
smallest_useful_product: Companion desktop/Android pair that transfers a selected batch on LAN, resumes chunks, hashes files, and creates a signed-style receipt listing source count, destination count, missing files, and safe-to-delete status.
constraints: Local-network permissions only, encrypted transport, preserve EXIF, respect Android storage restrictions, and be explicit that a receipt is only as good as the selected source set.
